description.value: Manteo Resort is a waterfront hotel and villas property on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, operating under the Eldorado Resort group. The resort sits along the lake corridor and offers access to the adjacent Eldorado Yacht Club, which provides kayak and paddleboard rentals alongside motorized watercraft. Touring cyclists would find it a scenic lakeside base for exploring Kelowna's wine country and the Okanagan rail trail network.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at manteo.com loaded but returned only 3027 bytes of content, primarily describing the Eldorado Yacht Club (boat rentals, moorage, kayaks) rather than hotel room or cycling amenities. The OSM email (refresh@eldoradoresort.ca) and the website branding ('Manteo at Eldorado Resort') confirm this is part of the Eldorado Resort group, but no hotel-specific amenity details are present in the fetched content. No cycling-specific amenities can be confirmed from either the website or OSM tags beyond the generic internet_access=wlan OSM tag.
concerns: Website fetched only 3027 bytes and is primarily Eldorado Yacht Club content — hotel amenity details are absent, so most fields cannot be confirmed.
